product: Agent Bricks documentation for code-first agent development
tagline: The Agent Bricks documentation now centers on building, deploying, and running custom agents in code.
what_it_does: The Agent Bricks documentation now centers on building, deploying, and running custom agents in code. DurableAgentServer and Agent Runtime: DurableAgentServer serves agents through the invocation API, with synchronous, streaming, and background runs, persistent run state, and crash recovery. Agent Runtime runs it on Databricks Apps.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
